messages:
jamie: Post-RFC sync: propose a compatibility/playbook model for fp8/int8/4bit profiles. goals: prevent silent regressions, allow controlled shims, and make rollouts tenant-auditable.

tara: Sounds good. What's the minimum metadata we need on each profile artifact?

owen: Minimum: profile_id, schema_id (int), compat_mode (strict|shim|fallback), created_ts, author, signature. signature = signing key digest so we can verify artifact integrity at load-time.

li: Also add an optional `hardware_hint` field for accelerated kernels to signal preferred code paths. runtime can ignore if unsupported.

jamie: Runtime decision table idea:
- strict: require checksum+signature match -> ACCEPT
- shim: accept + apply deterministic shim -> SHIM_APPLIED (emit shim_ms)
- fallback: do not use profile, route to fallback model -> FALLBACK_ROUTED

jamie: snippet of header (inline): ```json
{"profile_id":"rwd/fp8-2026-03","schema_id":301,"compat_mode":"shim","signature":"sig:aa11"}
```

owen: Observability: emit per-profile metrics: `profile.degradation_v2`, `profile.shim_latency_p50_ms`, `profile.shadow_diff_rate`. keep sample storage link as a tag.

tara: Define degradation_v2: weighted sum of avg-logprob-delta (0.6), token-swap-rate (0.3), embedding-cos-drop (0.1). Thresholds: >0.04 -> fail for strict; >0.02 -> warn for shim.

li: Perf datapoint from bench: deterministic shim adds ~1.6ms p50 for seq=64 on A10G; p95 ~3.9ms. H100 numbers lower but still material. We should put per-hardware shim estimates in the catalog.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled profile rwd/fp8-2026-03 -> prod-dedicated-us-east-2, 0.2% traffic (job: canary-1795). :rocket:

jamie: Migration/playbook: 1) publish as preview + shadow for 10d across 10k sampled prompts; 2) if metrics stable, run micro-canary 0.1% 24h -> expand 1% 48h -> 10% 72h; 3) enforce tenant policies: pinned tenants = strict; others may opt-in.

nowen: Need quick kill-switch: control-plane API to mark profile as disabled which causes runtime to revert to last-known-good or fallback. audit event must record reason and affected tenants.

tara: Tenant flags: `precision_pin_digest` (opt-in exact match), `allow_runtime_shim` boolean, `prefer_no_shim` route-level override. Default: pinned=false, allow_runtime_shim=false.

li: Interface for runtime: select_profile(request_meta, tenant_flags, profile_header) -> (decision_code, shim_id_opt, reason_text). decision_code in {ACCEPTED, SHIM_APPLIED, REJECTED}. Keep return tiny for perf.

jamie: Action items: owen -> draft proto + signing workflow PR; tara -> write degradation_v2 spec and eval harness; li -> bench shim latency per GPU and add catalog entries; ops -> add canary choreography & kill-switch to runbook. schedule 30m follow-up Mon.

ops-bot: reminder: canary-1795 will post status in #eng-ml in ~2h.
